title: Laser Definition
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly define the acronym laser as 'Light Amplification by Stimulated Emission of Radiation'.

title: Laser Output
description: Essential Criteria: The student must accurately describe the output of a laser as a highly coherent and directional beam.

title: FEL Mechanism
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain how the output is produced in the FEL, including the role of high energy electrons and the undulating magnetic field.

title: FEL Advantage
description: Important Criteria: The student must identify a specific advantage of the FEL over previous types of lasers, such as tunability or high peak power.

title: Energy Transfer
description: Optional Criteria: The student may discuss the synchronism condition and energy transfer between electrons and waves in detail.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as incorrect definitions or missing key components of the FEL mechanism.
